input.title: ZM3D Halloween app icon (App Store + Google Play)
input.description:
Halloween version of the live app icon (live since Sep 17) for the Halloween push.

**Direction (Robert, Seasonal art direction Q4 2025 + #zombie-art Sep 17):** seasonal layer only on top of the current icon. Same flat background, same pose, same zombie. Keep it as simple as the icon we have now. The busy Sep 17 concept is fine for an event but not for the icon.

**Timing (Arthur's Q4 release calendar):** the icon ships inside the build, so it has to go in the **Oct 17 submission**.
- Art to engineering by **Tue Oct 14**
- Merged by the **Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT** merge cut
- Submit Fri Oct 17. Apple review takes up to 3 days, so it's live from **Wed Oct 22**
- Also export the 512px Google Play hi-res listing icon
- Revert happens with the Nov 6 submission (icon back to normal)

Note: the swap can't happen on the 24th. The icon only changes with a new version, and Oct 17 is the last build that can carry Halloween changes.

Part of the ZM3D Halloween plan/tracker (links in Leonard's #zombie_marketing thread).

input.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 - Art plan
input.bodyText:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 - Art plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art Lead). For the Halloween review, Thu Oct 2, 9:00 PT. Please comment inline.
Tracker (one row per surface, with who/when/status): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1p3XlRyWQ4C-NPBrZKSEOMNpmHUJrSLMbaqnsRfr_x-k/edit

1. Goal
Leonard asked for everything players see from Zombie Match 3D to look like Halloween for the last stretch of October: both store pages and every ad we're running. This plan covers what's live today (the live creatives sheet, plus two live ads that aren't on it), the call for each one, who makes it and by when.

2. Inputs
- ZM3D live creatives sheet (Frederick): 56 Unity rows + 4 store surfaces
- Frederick's October UA plan (Sep 12) and his changes (Sep 30): the Halloween flight is now Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31 on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone. Android US tablet ends Sun Oct 12, so nothing that only runs there gets a Halloween version. Every Halloween ad has to be with Frederick by Wed Oct 15
- Frederick, Sep 29: squirrelfail landscape and mrfluffernot landscape are off iOS UK tablet and stay on Android US tablet only
- Frederick on the Trello Halloween card: julia 4:5 static (They're coming, stop them!, ART-826) is still live on iOS UK and is our best CPI there, but isn't on the sheet. Count it in
- ART-831 (Marcus's portrait UA end card) is live on Android US phone and plays after every Android US phone video, but isn't on the sheet either. Counted in
- Arthur's Q4 release calendar: the Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween changes. Merge cut is Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT. iOS screenshots only change with a new version. Apple review takes up to 3 days, so iOS goes live Wed Oct 22. Google Play listing graphics can go up any day with 1-day review. The Nov 6 submission puts things back to normal
- Robert's seasonal art direction (Q4 2025): dress on top of current art only. Anything captured or rendered before Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap + new background) gets redone on the current build first; if a newer capture has replaced it, the newest one counts. Videos with music baked into the master are re-cut from a no-music master first. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment); background, pose, zombie order and CTA stay the same so each variant tests clean against its normal version
- Capture/master notes and campaigns on every ad's ART ticket
- Existing Halloween work in Drive (ZM3D Halloween 2025): Martin's Halloween store screens (iPhone 6.5" x5, Google Play phone x6, Sep 30) and Marcus's Halloween cheer fastcouch 9:16 + 16:9 (Sep 29, from the no-music masters)

3. Calls (Robert's vocabulary)
- Halloween version: dress it from the current art
- Refresh first: re-capture, re-render or re-cut on the current build (no music) before the seasonal pass
- Reuse: a Halloween version already exists, use it
- Skip: no Halloween version this time

4. Store pages
- App icon (App Store + Google Play): Halloween version. Martin, ART-855 (new). Keep it as simple as today's icon (Robert). Art to engineering by Tue Oct 14 so it can be merged by the Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT cut, then it ships in the Oct 17 build and goes live Wed Oct 22. On swapping around the 24th: that can't happen. The icon is part of the build, and Oct 17 is the last build that can carry Halloween changes, so the earliest and only Halloween icon date is Oct 22. It goes back to normal with the Nov 6 submission
- iPhone 6.5" set: Reuse Martin's exported Halloween set. No ticket needed (already exported, per Leonard). Uploaded with the Oct 17 submission, live Oct 22, back with Nov 6
- iPad 12.9" set: Halloween version. Martin, ART-856 (new). There's no Halloween iPad set yet. Due Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT with the Oct 17 submission, live Oct 22, back with Nov 6
- Google Play phone set: Reuse Martin's exported Halloween set. Upload Fri Oct 17, so after the 1-day review it's live Sat Oct 18, lining up with the ad flight. Upload the normal set Sat Nov 1

5. Ads (58 live: the 56 on the sheet plus ART-826 and ART-831)
Summary: 11 Halloween version, 35 Refresh first, 2 Reuse, 10 Skip.
Every Halloween ad is due to Frederick Wed Oct 15. Refresh work is due Wed Oct 8, so there's a week left for the seasonal pass.
Who makes it, per Leonard: Marcus does video and end cards, Martin does stills.

Halloween version (11, Marcus): ART-817, 818, 819 (marcus.bennett 16:9/4:5/1:1, #1630); ART-833, 834, 835, 848 (end card 001 family, #1529); ART-851 (cheer fastcouch 4:5, #1896); ART-852 (barrel marketing2 1:1, #1896); ART-853 (couch alpha 50 4:5, #1935); ART-854 (balloons alpha 50 (1) 16:9, #1966).

Refresh first (35):
- Marcus, videos captured before #1452 (April-July builds, the Dec 2024 prototype, or Jul 28 #1427): ART-793, 794, 795, 797, 800, 801, 803, 804, 805, 810, 812, 814, 815, 823, 840 (keep the Boris opening), 841, 843, 845, 846, 850
- Marcus, old capture and music baked in (re-capture + no-music re-cut): ART-796, 798, 799, 802, 807, 847
- Marcus, current build but music baked in: ART-809 (marcus.bennett 9:16). Re-cut from his Aug 13 no-music master
- Marcus, end cards rendered before #1452: ART-831 (portrait UA end card, #1450 - plays after every Android US phone video, so priority), ART-832 (end card template 16:9, #456)
- Martin, julia statics made from #852 captures (Jun 5): ART-825, 826 (best iOS UK CPI), 827, 828, 829, 830
- Shortcuts: ART-795, 797 and 805 already have newer same-edit captures on their sibling formats (ART-853 #1935, ART-854 #1966, ART-852 #1896), so their refresh can start from those

Reuse (2): ART-808 cheer fastcouch 9:16 and ART-816 cheer fastcouch 16:9. Use Marcus's Sep 29 Halloween cuts in ZM3D Halloween 2025/UA masters.

Skip (10): runs only on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12. ART-806, 811, 813 (pulled from iOS UK tablet Sep 29), 820, 821, 822, 824, 842, 844, 849.

6. Who makes what, by when
- Marcus Bennett: 29 refreshes by Wed Oct 8, then 40 Halloween ads (29 refreshed + 11 Halloween versions) to Frederick by Wed Oct 15. The 2 reuse cuts are done
- Martin Walsh: 6 julia static refreshes by Wed Oct 8, Halloween versions to Frederick by Wed Oct 15; Halloween icon (ART-855) to eng by Tue Oct 14; Halloween iPad set (ART-856) by Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT. iPhone and Google Play sets are done
- Frederick Stone: queue Unity uploads as ads land, everything approved before Sat Oct 18; upload the Google Play Halloween set Fri Oct 17 and the normal set Sat Nov 1
- Arthur Blake: Halloween icon + iOS screenshots in the Oct 17 submission; revert in Nov 6
- Robert: sign-off on the icon direction and the first refreshed + Halloween cuts
- Claire: tracker, reviews of each pass, ticket hygiene

7. Risks / decisions for Thursday
- Marcus's load: 29 refreshes + 11 Halloween versions in two weeks is a lot. Options: have Frederick (who cut most of the originals) or Julia help with re-captures; or have Frederick pick which refreshes matter most, and pause the rest for the flight rather than run non-Halloween ads (Leonard wants every running ad to look like Halloween)
- Icon timing: Oct 22, not Oct 24 (see section 4). If the Oct 14 art handoff slips past the Oct 16 cut, there's no Halloween icon at all
- iOS store goes Halloween Oct 22, Google Play from Oct 18, ads from Oct 18. If we want the stores in sync, hold the Google Play upload until Oct 21
- Two live ads (ART-826, ART-831) aren't on the live creatives sheet; Frederick may want to add them

8. Tickets
- Every live ad's ART ticket has a comment with its call and due date. Halloween version / Refresh first tickets are assigned to Marcus (video, end cards) or Martin (stills)
- New store art tickets: ART-855 (Halloween icon), ART-856 (Halloween iPad set), both Martin
